summary: PASS. End-to-end verified Promethius chat + API-key management. Backend: all 6 pytest cases green (chat via Universal Key for gpt-4o-mini, Anthropic claude-sonnet-4-6 routed through the proxy, PDF tool-calling loop returns /api/files/*.pdf link, GET/PUT /api/settings/keys shape + persistence + non-admin 403). Frontend: WebAuthn passkey registration via CDP virtual authenticator on /login worked, user redirected to '/' Orb, /chat rendered assistant reply 'I am Promethius, your personal AI…' via Universal Key, Settings > API tab shows Universal Key banner ('Chat is ready out of the box …'), all six apikey-input-* + apikey-status-* elements, and the correct read-only mode for non-admin (save-apikeys-button intentionally hidden by ApiKeysTab when role !== 'admin'; backend PUT already covered admin flow).

issues: Playbook mentions /auth path, but the actual React route is /login (App.js). Any external docs/redirects pointing at /auth will 404 into an empty <App/> shell. Consider adding a <Route path="/auth" element={<Navigate to="/login" replace/>}/> alias.

action_items: OPTIONAL: alias /auth -> /login in App.js routes to match the playbook and any legacy links (non-blocking).

That's correct; if you need a UI-side admin verification with save-apikeys-button visible, run the same test using the seeded admin owner@example.com (currently no passkey, only password) — either seed a passkey for the admin or add a dev-only password login form.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1417-1418: chat_ready correctly OR's OpenAI key with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — chat truly works out-of-the-box.
server.py L1427-1444 (set_keys): admin-guarded, empty string resets to env default via _apply_key + _ENV_KEY_DEFAULTS, non-empty encrypted via _gh_fernet. Persistence verified.
VoiceSettings.jsx ApiKeysTab hides save button when user.role !== 'admin' — safe UX, matches backend require_admin.
Auth.jsx uses data-testid consistently. Passkey register/login through webauthn library on WEBAUTHN_EXPECTED_ORIGIN worked with CDP virtual authenticator (protocol=ctap2, internal, RK+UV).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter22_chat_and_keys.py is a good regression harness for future changes to /api/chat, /api/settings/keys and Universal Key routing. Frontend Auth page lives at /login (not /auth). To CDP-register a passkey use protocol=ctap2, transport=internal, hasResidentKey=true, hasUserVerification=true, isUserVerified=true, automaticPresenceSimulation=true, then click auth-toggle-mode → fill auth-name-input + auth-email-input (use example.com; .local is rejected) → auth-submit-button. Chat reply typically returns within ~4-6s.
